name: Network People Services Technologies Ltd
title: Network People Services Technologies Ltd - 544396 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue ~INR 209 crore with EBITDA margin falling to about 31-33%, negative operating cash flow from longer TSP credit periods, and a 70% revenue CAGR target with no capacity or capex data.

triggers.label: Negative operating cash flow in FY26
triggers.quote: We have generated the negative cash flow from operations in FY26.

triggers.label: 70% revenue CAGR to FY29
triggers.quote: We are in the range of INR 850 crores to INR 900 crores by the end of FY29.

triggers.label: International ~40% of FY27 target in kitty
triggers.quote: Almost 40% is in our kitty right now at the beginning of the year.

guidance.value: 70% for next three years; INR 850-900 crore by FY29
guidance.quote: We are in the range of INR 850 crores to INR 900 crores by the end of FY29.

guidance.value: Improving from ~10% higher to 40%-50% over time
guidance.quote: the EBITDA margin will start improving from nothing less than 10% higher.

guidance.value: Expected to decline as mix shifts away from TSP
guidance.quote: Our target is to improve this business mix that will have major impact on improvisation of payment terms from FY27 onwards.

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow in FY26
red_flags.quote: We have generated the negative cash flow from operations in FY26.

red_flags.label: Receivable days elevated from longer TSP credit periods
red_flags.quote: we had created longer credit period in our business.

red_flags.label: Unfunded 70% CAGR with no absolute FY27 figure
red_flags.quote: anywhere around that, 70% should look good. That's what we are targeting.

red_flags.label: Inorganic capital (INR 300 crore Tata MF) undeployed
red_flags.quote: there are a couple of deals we have said no right now

evasions.quote: I would suggest that you see this year, because there is a tremendous trigger from the SaaS and the international revenue coming in.
I believe that this will decrease gradually over a period of time because of change in mix in our entire business.
We have given this number because there is an execution going on for the international one.
